notes: Strong pressure on an open HQ and a good Docklands Pass + Maintenance Access finish (T8). Main mistake was T6: Window of Opportunity derezzed Ping and then the Runner ran into it with 1 credit, but Ping cost 3 to break with Tremolo and the Corp could afford to rerez it, so the run ended and gave a tag. T1 Bravado into the unrezzed R&D ice cost Debbie to Doomscroll.

Fast Hybrid Release scores (T2, T4), but on T3 an agenda sat overnight in a naked Server 3 and Sericulture Expansion behind only Tatu-Bola was stolen by Rising Tide. On T6-T7 the Corp clicked for credits at 7-10 credits with 4-5 cards in hand instead of advancing, which let a passive Runner drag the game to T12.

Good HQ raids on T1-T2 and R&D digs on T6/T8, then on T5, T7 and T9-T11 the Runner only clicked for credits (up to 22) with 5 cards in grip and installed nothing. They never got a breaker for the Afshar on Server 1 (facechecked on T4), so Above the Law (T8) and Divested Trust (T12) were scored without any contest.

Sensible ice and steady scoring behind Hagen/Ansel/Tithe, but it took 19 turns against a Runner who clicked for credits for ten turns. Problems: draw/credit clicks on T4 and T8, Nico Campaign in a naked Server 4 (T12, trashed), only one advance on T16 with 13 credits, and Megaprix Qualifier behind a single Hagen was Overclocked on T5.

Early steals were good (Witch Hunt T3, Post-Truth Dividend T4, Stoke the Embers T11), but on T13-T15 the Runner made repeated Docklands HQ runs that saw the same Congratulations!/N-Pot and spent credits removing tags each turn. By T16 they had 1 credit, facechecked Starlit Knight unbroken and Piranhas, and could not contest Server 1, where Stoke the Embers was scored for the win on T17.

R&D had only Wave, which does not end the run, and gave up Megaprix (T2, T7) and Architect Deployment Test (T3). On T3 the Corp stacked more ice on the Otto Campaign server instead of fixing that. On T8-T9 it sat on 20+ credits clicking for credits and discarding, with Eli 1.0/Ansel 1.0 in hand, while Méliès City Luxury Line in HQ had only Ablative Barrier and was stolen for the loss on T9.

Efficient: early R&D pressure, Remastered Edition stolen from HQ on T5, then Gauss broke Klevetnik for three straight remote steals (T6-T8). Economy stayed near 0-1 credits and a Public Trail tag was left on all game, which was risky but went unpunished. The Living Mural install (T3) did little.

Facechecked Tree Line and Afshar on T2 and Tree Line again on T4 with no breaker for either. On T5-T8 and T10-T12 the Runner only clicked for credits (up to 28) holding 5 cards and installing nothing. On T9 it ran into Afshar four times in a row, unbroken, losing 8 credits. Corp scored four agendas out of a Tree Line remote uncontested.

Urtica Cipher traps did well early, but on T4 the Corp played Bring Them Home and ended the turn with 2 clicks unused, and on T5 Neurospike did nothing for 3 credits. Hybrid Release was installed into Server 4 on T6 and again on T7 with 0 credits to rez its second ice, and both were stolen. Longevity Serum was taken from a one-ice HQ and Lotus Haze/Regenesis from an R&D that was never iced further.

Very short game: a normal T1 setup, then rezzing Anemone and trashing an HQ card for extra net damage, plus the Jinteki ID ping, flatlined the Runner, who had already damaged itself with Esâ and Finality. Not much to judge, but every decision was correct.

T1 rezzed Mestnichestvo with all 5 credits and left Next Big Thing in a one-ice remote, advanced on T2 with 0 credits, and it was stolen. The Corp then spent T7-T17 advancing ice, declining Federal Fundraising draws and discarding to hand size instead of scoring. On T16 it paid 7 credits for Oppo Research tags with no follow-up, and needed 30 turns to beat a Runner that only clicked for credits.

Built a sound Buzzsaw/Leech/Trickster Taka R&D lock that won, but slowly (T17). On T2 the Runner reran HQ into a known Ballista right after the Gachapon Buzzsaw install, lost Buzzsaw and paid 4 to reinstall it. Repeated draws into a full grip forced discards (T9, T11, T12, T14), and on T13 it facechecked Envelopment on Archives for nothing.

T2 put Post-Truth Dividend behind a lone Paywall, which the Runner simply paid through. Then on T3 the Corp installed a second Post-Truth Dividend in the same server with 0 credits, and it was stolen the same way. With 13 credits on T7 it left Next Big Thing at 2 advances behind Paywall plus one ice, and it was stolen for the loss.

Excellent Red Team R&D runs reached 6 points by T4 (Longevity Serum, Hybrid Release, Fujii). On T9 the Runner ran Server 1 into a known Saisentan with Revolver out of counters and only 3 cards in grip, and was flatlined: a foreseeable loss with 1 point to go.

Won via Fujii from HQ, Yagi-Uda from Archives and late R&D steals. On T3 and T5 the Runner ran unadvanced naked remotes into Urtica Cipher with a small grip against Jinteki, losing Revolver and other cards. The economy sat at 0-2 credits for most of the game, which meant facechecking Anemone unbroken (T7, T10, T12, T13) and no chance to contest the Fujii scored on T6.

On T6, T8 and T9 the Corp clicked for credits at 10-19 credits and discarded to hand size instead of installing and scoring, and installed its first agenda only on T10. Méliès City Luxury Line (T11) and Project Ingatan (T13) were stolen from an HQ guarded by a single Eli 1.0, losing the game.

Fast start with 5 points by T6, but T1 Raindrops into unrezzed HQ ice lost Boi-tatá to Ballista. After the first Measured Response (T6) the Runner spent its credits on Privileged Access reinstalls and ended T7 with 3 credits and 3 cards. A second Measured Response on T8 flatlined it, which was foreseeable after the first one.

The Corp never scored a point. Vicsek trashed itself on T3, leaving R&D open until T6, and Hybrid Release was stolen from it on T5. On T5 the Corp played Neurospike for no effect and spent most clicks from T3 to T8 on single credits at 3-7 credits. Flower Sermon was lost from HQ on T2, and the final Sericulture Expansion (T9) was installed into a remote that the Runner broke through.

Kept the agendas safe behind Hagen, Eli and Ansel and closed with Seamless Launch on T18, but money was very tight early (0-3 credits T2-T5) after rezzing Nico Campaign. Nico Campaign was trashed from unprotected remotes on T2, T8 and T17, wasting clicks and credits.

Took 3 points from an open R&D on T1-T2, then from T5 to T28 almost only clicked for credits (up to 79) holding 5 cards and installed no breakers. Late runs (T19 Funhouse, T20 Capacitor, T26 Klevetnik) were facechecks it could not break. The Corp scored Remastered Edition twice, Artificial Cryptocrash and Next Big Thing with no meaningful contest.
